subject: ela
intro: Seventh graders present claims and findings, emphasizing salient (most important) points in a focused, coherent manner with pertinent descriptions, facts, details, and examples; they use appropriate eye contact, adequate volume, and clear pronunciation. A good presentation is organized, well supported, and clearly delivered.

items.prompt: What does it mean to emphasize SALIENT points in a presentation?

steps: Salient means most important or striking.
So you highlight your most important points so the audience remembers them.
solution.answer: Highlight your most important points for the audience.

items.prompt: Name two aspects of effective DELIVERY.

steps: Delivery is how you speak and present.
Eye contact, volume, and clear pronunciation all matter.
So two are eye contact and adequate volume.
solution.answer: Eye contact and adequate volume (also clear pronunciation).

items.prompt: Why support claims with facts, details, and examples in a presentation?

steps: Support makes your claims convincing and clear.
So evidence makes the presentation credible and persuasive.
solution.answer: It makes the presentation credible and convincing.

items.prompt: The most important points are the ____ points.
Looking at your audience is ____ contact.
